decisions.rationale: Mossy boulders (four variants): displaced, flattened stones with moss over their upper faces; at most 320 triangles per variant, 118,828 bytes before meshopt; each variant normalised to its collider and checked inside it (world-v3 prop collider test).
limitations: Scripted tubes and displaced primitives: no peeling bark, rot, hollow cores or fungus.

decisions.rationale: On the dark forest floor, between the trees, at gameplay cameras (18-40 m, pitch 0.38-1.13): knee to chest high beside the 2.25 m soldier, the 2.7 m captain and the 3.9 m boss, collides with its measured footprint and stands on the terrain (logs pitched to the slope).
limitations: The same four variants repeat across a forest, varied only by scale and turn.
